learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire the ability to apply basic mathematics and engineering knowledge to problems in the field of chemical technologies.
Students become capable of teamwork and open to information sharing.

Students gain the ability to identify and define problems in the field of chemical technologies, and to solve problems effectively using modern engineering techniques and tools, along with composition technologies.
Students become quality-conscious, sensitive to social issues, and aware of the importance of environmental health and safety.
Students are educated with the awareness that they must continuously update themselves by following developments in science and technology.

syllabus_topics: Fossil Fuels: Coal, Petroleum, Natural Gas Technologies
